title: Phone: City IT Director — before the domain reset

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: City IT Director
transcript.text: Priya, it’s Kevin. The note on the file server names the City and asks for 38 bitcoin within 72 hours. I’m pulling MBW-BKP-01’s cable and stopping the backup jobs.

transcript.speaker: City IT Director
transcript.text: I want to reset every MILLBROOK domain admin password and disable svc-backup in the next ten minutes — but your MBWSCADA domain trusts ours.

transcript.speaker: City IT Director
transcript.text: Does anything on the plant side log in with a MILLBROOK account? If I’m about to break something you need, tell me now.

voiceStyles.City IT Director: Man in his 40s, fast and tense, keyboard clatter behind

instructorNote: City IT is doing the right things fast. The hurdle is the trust: the SCADA / IT Security Manager has to know what depends on it. Push for the trust to be broken or FW-R-14 blocked, and for MBW-EWS-01 to stay powered on.

snapshot.title: Phone Call: Lab LIMS Unreachable — Water Quality Manager

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Marcus here. LIMS (MBW-LIMS-01) is down—can't reach the server. The daily chlorine sampling log for Zone 3 was due at 09:00 and I can't access it. The local lab database is still running, but the central archive on MBW-FS-01 is unreachable. I’m using paper sheets to record the results, but I can’t file them. I’m not sure if the lab has been hit or if it’s a network issue.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms a cascading failure in data integrity. The Water Quality Manager is now operating manually, which increases risk of error and delays in reporting. Watch for whether he contacts Ohio EPA DDAGW or declares a Level 3 incident based on the ERP.
